review_trigger: provider fix and Sabueso B3 integration disposition before 0.15.0
provider_checkout_before_and_after: clean; no source/file/cache/environment changes made in MolSysMT
import_mode: Shared Python 3.14 editable checkout; module and installed metadata agree. Foreign test package is isolated without adding the checkout root to PYTHONPATH.

capabilities.assembly: Public build.make_bioassembly supports named or explicit common-chain operation dictionaries, selected structures, proper rotations and unit-bearing translations.
capabilities.rigid_transforms: Public structure.rotate and structure.translate with independent analytic receiving.
capabilities.contacts: Public structure.get_contacts supports explicit atomic endpoints, unit-bearing inclusive thresholds and PBC choice. Group-center semantics differ from minimum atom-distance group contacts; output_indices=group is refused.
capabilities.storage: Validated native operations and length units have H5MSM round-trip tests.

limits.heterogeneous_chain_scopes: Stored per-operation scopes can persist, but make_bioassembly explicitly raises NotImplementedError when different operations select different chain sets.
limits.source_generator_loss: Confirmed importer defect #563; repeated assembly-id generator rows silently overwrite earlier rows. Direct common-chain two-operation building succeeds.
limits.input_handoff: Sabueso currently retains symbolic operation identifiers/text, not the numeric matrices/vectors/atomic coordinate inputs required by these calls. Same entry/revision and native label_asym_id/chain_id correspondence must be qualified.
limits.output_identity: Generated chain_id values are unique labels; chain_name retains author names and may repeat. Original declaration/component/operation correspondence must remain explicit.
limits.default_selection: Select assembly and structure indices deliberately; default None picks the first stored assembly and default structure_indices=0 picks structure zero. Neither is a scientific recommendation.
limits.contact_scope: Declare threshold, atom/center semantics, structures, indices and PBC. Even pair output retains a dense boolean map; bounded workload receiving is needed.
limits.qualification: 62 selected local cases and one synthetic reproducer do not qualify all provider routes, a public installed artifact or a Sabueso modeling bridge.

pytest_warnings: Four expected LegacyH5MSMWarning messages from bundled 0.4 inputs; reading remains supported.

provider_defect.review_trigger: owning MolSysMT provider issue and B3 integration
provider_defect.kind: explicitly synthetic assembly metadata over bundled public 1BRS coordinates
provider_defect.interpretation: The mmCIF converter retains only the last generator row for the same assembly id. The direct common-chain two-operation builder correctly constructs both coordinate copies. This is separate from the documented unsupported heterogeneous per-operation chain sets.

harness_notes: The initial report exporter was corrected for a list of unit-bearing translations. An initial PYTHONPATH-based test setup shadowed installed metadata with older ignored egg-info; final selected/reproducer gates avoid that path and verify SDK322. Initial logs remain separate from final receiving.
scope_decision: Engine availability is now observed. Requirement/scheduling of an integrated geometric journey remains a maintainer decision; no accepted 0.15.0 scope is removed.
owned_evidence: recovered_work/molsysmt_capability_review_20261104/; scripts, original hashes, results and initial/final logs retained until provider receiving/B3 disposition.
